about: Every boat class (standard 18 home table). Two are built to ride (dugout, sea-hull); skiff and river-boat are typed and priced only until a later phase builds them (0159). Sizes from apps/world-studio/public/kits/watercraft-v1.footprints.json; cruise, wave limit and price from docs/phases/2-slice/2.15-boats research section 4.1. draughtM is derived, not authored: the depth at which the class hull cut convex body (game-core settlement/buoyantHull.ts over the published watercraft-v1 mesh, hullAssetIds[0]) displaces its water-motion class massKg of fresh water (rowboat 250 kg for dugout and skiff, barge 1500 kg for river-boat and sea-hull), rounded to 1 cm; game-core boats/draught.test.ts recomputes it and fails past 2 cm. A mooring socket's accepts[] and every Boat record's classId name an id here.

recovery.about: A lost or adrift boat returns to its last tied mooring after a rest, or a boat-keeper brings it for a fee of ceil(percent of price), never under minGold (0159).
